scenes.narration: You built the business. Marketing still needs attention. Meet HireZero: a marketing employee with a desk of its own.

scenes.title: Give Claw context.
scenes.subtitle: Your audience. Your voice. Your boundaries.
scenes.narration: Start with your business: what you sell, who you serve, and what you can honestly claim. Claw keeps that context beside the work.

scenes.narration: Give it an outcome. For this introduction, the brief is simple: show useful work, speak to founders, and avoid unsupported claims.

scenes.subtitle: Why it matters. What is ready. Your next decision.
scenes.narration: The cockpit brings the decision into focus: why this matters, what is prepared, and what Claw recommends. Review the package, change direction, or park it.

scenes.title: Keep the pieces together.
scenes.subtitle: Plan, drafts, page copy, claims and blockers—in one review.
scenes.narration: Open the campaign and the pieces stay together: the plan, the central angle, drafts, page copy, and the details still waiting on you.

scenes.title: See what changed.
scenes.subtitle: Specific feedback. Visible revisions. A decision you can inspect.
scenes.narration: Feedback has somewhere to go. Compare the earlier draft with the revision, check the supporting claims, and send back a precise note when something needs work.
